title: III الكناية هاء
titleEn: Hāʾ al-Kināyahʿ on particular words - أَرْجِئْهُ
description: Rules regarding the recitation of the word أَرْجِئْهُ. This particular word has two potential differences between the qira'at which lead to a number of possible combinations. The first set of differences pertain to whether or not the hamzah will be read. The second set of differences pertain to how the hāʾ al-kināyah will be read.

arjih_hamza_qasr.title: Hamzah and qaṣr on the hāʾ al-kināyah with ḍammah of أَرْجِئْهُ
arjih_hamza_qasr.description: Imam Abu 'Amr will recite this word with the hamzah and will make qaṣr of hāʾ al-kināyah with ḍammah.

arjih_hamza_silah.title: Hamzah and ṣilah on the hāʾ al-kināyah with ḍammah of أَرْجِئْهُۥ
arjih_hamza_silah.description: Imams Ibn Kathir and Hisham will recite this word with the hamzah and will make ṣilah of hāʾ al-kināyah with ḍammah.

arjih_hamza_qasr_kasrah.title: Hamzah and qaṣr on the hāʾ al-kināyah with kasrah of أَرْجِئْهِ
arjih_hamza_qasr_kasrah.description: Imam Ibn Dhakwān will recite this word with the hamzah and will make qaṣr of hāʾ al-kināyah with kasrah.

arjih_no_hamza_qasr_kasrah.title: No hamzah and qaṣr on the hāʾ al-kināyah of أَرْجِهِ
arjih_no_hamza_qasr_kasrah.description: Imam Qalun will recite this word without the hamzah and will make qaṣr of hāʾ al-kināyah.

arjih_no_hamza_silah_kasrah.title: No hamzah and ṣilah on the hāʾ al-kināyah of أَرْجِهِۦ
arjih_no_hamza_silah_kasrah.description: Imams Warsh and Kisai will recite this word without the hamzah and will make ṣilah of hāʾ al-kināyah.

arjih_no_hamza_sukoon.title: No hamzah and sukoon on the hāʾ al-kināyah of أَرْجِهْ
arjih_no_hamza_sukoon.description: Imams 'Asim and Hamzah will recite this word without the hamzah and will make sukūn on hāʾ al-kināyah.
